name: Kingspan
verdict: Main shirt sponsor of Uruguay (Los Teros). Kingspan is the brand of Kingspan Group plc, the Irish building-products company; the 2024 Grenfell Tower Inquiry final report found 'deeply entrenched and persistent dishonesty' in its marketing of K15 insulation.
note: Rating note: proposed 'concern' (company record: Grenfell Tower public inquiry, September 2024, on Kingspan's dishonest marketing of K15 insulation; two press corroborations from BBC and The Guardian). ON HOLD for a maintainer: the method's company-record list cites a court, regulator, UN body or major NGO; a statutory public inquiry's own findings are not expressly covered, and the inquiry found the insulation type immaterial to the 2017 fire's spread (its findings concern K15's marketing for high-rise buildings generally). Kingspan announced the sponsorship of Los Teros in May 2024 (its global Facebook and Kingspan Isoeste/Kingspan Uruguay social accounts; bot-blocked from scripts). kingspan.com is bot-blocked (Anubis).
